summary.text: Michael Farley is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Farley previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Hillsborough 15, from 2006 to 2010.

paragraphs.text: Michael Farley assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Hillsborough 15, in 2006 and left office in 2010.
On November 4, 2008, he was re-elected to the district, finishing third among the candidates for the three seats.
Farley failed to advance past the November 2, 2010, general election, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as legislator.
